new_material_candidates.name: ContDa — Continual Documentation Adaptation
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Directly addresses continual agent adaptation when tool APIs and documentation evolve, using relation-guided exploration and relation-aware documentation adjustment while explicitly measuring both adaptation and retention.

aliases: enabling open-world tool use via agentic learning
new_material_candidates.name: ToolOmni
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides a released learned open-world tool-use agent with proactive retrieval, grounded execution, supervised cold start, and multi-objective reinforcement learning over retrieval and execution.

new_material_candidates.canonical_name: Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
aliases: prototype-based test-time adaptation of vision-language models
new_material_candidates.name: PTA — Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Uses class-specific knowledge prototypes to accumulate information from test samples without backpropagation or growing retrieval caches, creating a materially distinct adaptation and resource profile.

reference_or_screened.name: APOLLO — Preference Following in Tool Calling Language Agents
reference_or_screened.reason: Its distinguishing decision contract requires explicit or implicit user preferences from interaction histories; it becomes claim-bearing only for a matched preference-conditioned tool-use experiment.

reference_or_screened.name: CAPS — Cross-modal Agentic Policy Self-distillation
reference_or_screened.reason: It transfers policy behavior between text-history and visual-history representations inside agent tasks; this is not one learned decision mechanism spanning Hetren E1, E2, and E3, and executable code was not verified.

reference_or_screened.name: TTP — Test-Time Padding
reference_or_screened.reason: Its primary contract is adversarial detection plus targeted adaptation, and the CVPR page states code release rather than supplying a verified executable implementation.

reference_or_screened.name: IMA and TMA
reference_or_screened.reason: Useful lightweight embedding-space adaptation evidence, but it does not presently alter the claim-bearing archival E3 pool.

stopping_rule.reason: At least one materially new applicable comparator was found, so the no-new-material counter resets to zero.
